data.long_meaning: Ania is derived from the Greek word ‘anias’, which means ‘grace’ or ‘mercy’. It is a name deeply rooted in the Christian faith, symbolizing God's unending love and compassion. The name Ania carries the meaning “Grace, mercy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ania usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
